# Set up your Google Business Profile

[In this article](https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/7689-set-up-google-business-profile-with-square#)

[About Google Business Profile](https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/7689-set-up-google-business-profile-with-square#9d17ae04160950ccc48f9bee7fa37fde) [Before you begin](https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/7689-set-up-google-business-profile-with-square#135b308ed83c53f1516b7c754566d1c4) [Sync Square with Google](https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/7689-set-up-google-business-profile-with-square#9ef215ec8fd53b51e55443afea89a524) [Edit locations synced with Google Business Profile](https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/7689-set-up-google-business-profile-with-square#18810bd707a3955744ddaa3b27be23aa) [Disconnect your business locations from Google](https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/7689-set-up-google-business-profile-with-square#2074c688d2b32450586c7c53a0dd526e) [Related articles](https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/7689-set-up-google-business-profile-with-square#164a2c547e23be9feca13912598efd75)

## About Google Business Profile

With Google Business Profile, the details of your brick and mortar store and website display in Google Search and Google Maps results. Google Business Profile also syncs with:

- Order with Google

- Google Listings & Google Enhanced Listings


By syncing your Google Business Profile with Square, you can seamlessly manage your Google presence directly from your Square Dashboard. You can also form your business identity on Google, connect with customers, post updates, list your products and services, and accept online orders.

## Before you begin

- You can sync your account with Google, edit locations synced with Google, and disconnect your account from Google from your Square Dashboard. If you need to troubleshoot outside of your Square Dashboard or Square app, reference the [Google help center](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7107242?hl=en).

- Google requires a physical location to create a Google Business Profile. Online-only businesses that sell virtually are not eligible to sync their virtual locations to Google.

- If you decide to connect your Square account to your Google account and sync your Square locations with Google Business Profile, we will also send Google any of the following information that you’ve entered in Square: business name, business description, business address & location coordinates, business category, business type (mobile or physical), business hours, business phone number, business website links, business logo. You can review, edit, and delete this information ahead of time or while setting up your Google connection. You can also stop sharing data at any time.

- Steps in this article only apply if you have a website but not an online ordering profile. To set up your online ordering profile with Google Business Profile and Order with Google, learn how to [set up and manage your online ordering profile](https://squareup.com/help/article/8566-set-up-an-online-ordering-profile).


## Sync Square with Google

## [From Locations in Square Dashboard](https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/7689-set-up-google-business-profile-with-square\#)

1. Sign in to Square Dashboard and go to **Settings** \> **Account & Settings** \> **My business** \> [**Locations**](https://app.squareup.com/dashboard/locations).
2. From the Google Business Profile banner, click **Get started**.
3. Click **Sign in with Google**.
4. Select your Google business account in the pop-up window.
5. Review the requirements, then click **Allow**.
6. Select the category that best fits your business and click **Continue**.
7. Fill out the fields with your business information.
8. Click **Publish**.

## [From Sales channels in Square Dashboard](https://squareup.com/help/us/en/article/7689-set-up-google-business-profile-with-square\#)

1. Sign in to Square Dashboard and go to **Online** \> [**Sales channels**](https://app.squareup.com/dashboard/online-channels/overview) .
2. Under Google Business Profile, click **Set up**.
3. Click **Sign in with Google**.
4. Select your Google business account in the pop-up window.
5. Review the requirements, then click **Allow**.
6. Select the category that best fits your business and click **Continue**.
7. Fill out the fields with your business information.
8. Click **Publish**.

Once you sync your location with Google through Square, you need to verify your location with Google. Visit the [Google help center](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7107242?hl=en) to learn how to verify your business on Google. Once you successfully add your Google Business Profile to Square, your profile should appear under your Locations as **Synced**.

## Edit locations synced with Google Business Profile

Any edits you make to a Square location automatically sync with Google.

1. Sign in to Square Dashboard and go to **Settings** \> **Account & Settings** \> **My business** \> [Locations](https://app.squareup.com/dashboard/locations).

2. Select a location with the status **Synced**.

3. Make any changes and click **Save**.


## Disconnect your business locations from Google

If you disconnect your business location with your Google Business Profile, your business information stops syncing with Google. Your location will remain visible on Google, and you can still manage the locations separately from your Google Business Profile.

1. Sign in to Square Dashboard and go to **Settings** \> **Account & Settings** \> **My business** \> [Locations](https://app.squareup.com/dashboard/locations).

2. Select the synced location you want to disconnect.

3. Click **Disconnect**.
